description:
[Wicked Registry] PERMANENTLY revoke a Registry API key (the one presented). Use if a key leaked. Pass api_key, or set REGISTRY_API_KEY.

Use when a Registry API key leaked or is no longer needed and must be disabled permanently. Not for inspecting a key (use registry_key_info).

Behavior: DESTRUCTIVE and not reversible; confirm intent before calling.

api_key.description: Registry API key to revoke. Overrides REGISTRY_API_KEY.

name: registry_revoke_key
